Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production RPG full-body attack animation sprite sheet.
Use the supplied image as the exact character identity, costume, body-proportion, color, and hair reference. The subject is Lucky Burns, an adult fictional female RPG fighter.
Create ONE square 2048x2048 PNG sheet with exactly SIX separate full-body poses on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Layout is exactly THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, reading left-to-right across top row then bottom row. No visible grid, frame borders, labels, text, numbers, backdrop, floor, cast shadows or watermarks. Each of the six poses must remain inside its own cell, generous transparent margin. Consistent local anchor within each cell: head near 12% cell height and feet near 91%, center of hips near horizontal 50%. Entire body and all limbs/hair/props visible in every cell; never crop, overlap adjacent cells, add extra figures or change the scale.
Six coherent sequential animation frames for ONE attack facing slightly toward screen right: (1) ready stance derived from reference, (2) anticipation with free fist drawn back and subtle weight shift, (3) decisive free-arm punch to screen right, (4) follow-through with torso twist and secondary hair movement, (5) recovery retracting fist, (6) return closely to frame 1. Keep feet near anchor and body size consistent; only natural limb articulation, weight shift and hair secondary motion.
Preserve the exact adult face, blue eye color, very long voluminous wavy golden-blonde hair, very muscular powerful build and body proportions from reference, including large strong thighs and arms. Preserve all exact outfit coverage, shape, colors, crown motifs and visible accessories; do not redesign or invent costume, props or weapons. Detailed, richly shaded crisp pixel-art RPG finish closely following the reference rendering, attractive readable sprite silhouettes. Combat animation, neutral game framing.
Skin-specific invariants: oversized white off-shoulder sweatshirt with red crown on chest and black shoulder strap, black athletic shorts with white piping/drawstring and small red crown, fluffy white slide slippers with red crowns, red hair scrunchie/accessory. Her raised hand at screen right holds the reference WHITE mug with RED crown; preserve that mug in the SAME hand upright and stable in ALL six poses. The other arm, initially near shorts pocket, leaves the pocket and performs the punch; do not punch with the mug.
